summary: Turn a topic into an original narrated audiobook and listen on your Kobo. Needs an account.
release_notes: Rebuilt with the current Cobalt SDK.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
A book is researched by Exa, written by OpenAI and narrated by ElevenLabs, on your own accounts. Create an API key with each and save them in private files: ~/.exa, ~/.openai and ~/.elevenlabs.
Open Audiobook Studio and type a topic. It shows the time and cost before anything is spent: about 3 to 8 minutes and $1 to $5 a book. The free sample plays with no keys.
